prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Waiting screen enhancements (wait_info) can be helpful, producing significant gains in two tests (+5.0% and +5.7%), though one test showed no clear effect.
Adding new screens (new_screen) had mixed results: the pet preview screen won with a large gain (+15.4%), but the quiz screen significantly hurt performance (-7.7%).
Copy adjustments (copy), layout changes (layout), sign-in reordering (reorder), tutorials (redesign), and hints (hint) showed no clear effect across all tests.
Predictions underestimated large wins, such as the pet preview screen (+3.0% predicted vs +15.4% measured).
Predictions were generally too high for changes that showed no clear effect or resulted in a loss (e.g., predicting +15.4% for the quiz screen which measured -7.7%).

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, copy: -0.5% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, new_screen: +3.9% over 2 test(s)
- choose_path, hint: -2.2% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, layout: -1.4% over 1 test(s)
- finish, hint: +5.6% over 1 test(s)
- finish, redesign: -3.0% over 1 test(s)
- home, wait_info: +4.1% over 3 test(s)
- sign_in, copy: +0.4% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: +3.1% over 1 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 70.5%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 88.5%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 22.5%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] Story Screen Animated Companion Showcase: Redesign the story screen into a centered spotlight view featuring animated companion showcases that highlight core pet behaviors. (why: The choose_path step has a long mean completion time (514s) and 76.2% conversion, showing a need for an immediate engaging visual hook.)
1: [sign_in, copy] Existing Account Pet Recovery Headline: Update the sign-in screen headline and body text to explicitly reassure returning users that logging into their account restores missing pets. (why: Support received 8 emails about pets missing or reset after signing in again, making post-sign-in data loss anxiety a key friction point.)
2: [adoption, redesign] Pick Friend Split Comparison Layout: Rebuild the pick friend screen layout into a split comparison view featuring side-by-side choice cards and visual previews. (why: Adoption has a 70.5% conversion rate and takes a mean of 1017s; a side-by-side comparative layout reduces decision fatigue.)
3: [home, wait_info] Desktop Controls Quick Reference on Waiting Screen: Display a quick reference carousel on the waiting screen explaining basic mouse clicks and shortcut commands for desktop pets. (why: Wait screen info updates proved effective in earlier tests (+5.0% and +5.7%), and support received multiple complaints regarding unclear pet controls.)
4: [adoption, new_screen] Pet Customization Sound & Voice Selection Screen: Add a dedicated pet voice and sound selection screen prior to photo upload so users can pick companion audio traits. (why: Adding customization screens during adoption previously yielded a +15.4% conversion increase by boosting attachment to the pet.)
5: [choose_path, hint] Quick Start Path Guidance Hint: Add an inline guidance hint explaining that pet traits and selected paths can be easily modified later in settings. (why: The mean time spent on choose_path is 514s (vs 8s median), indicating users get stuck trying to make a permanent choice.)
6: [sign_in, layout] Centered Single-Column Sign In Layout: Change the sign-in screen to a centered single-column layout to reduce visual noise and simplify login. (why: Sign-in conversion sits at 72.9% with a high mean completion time of 567s, suggesting visual distraction during authentication.)
7: [finish, copy] Desktop Placement Troubleshooting Headline: Update the home intro headline and body with explicit troubleshooting steps if the pet does not automatically display on screen. (why: The finish step has the highest drop rate among final screens (64.8%), driven partly by users whose pets fail to appear visually.)
8: [home, wait_info] Pet Voice Command Tips on Waiting Screen: Add interactive tips on the waiting screen demonstrating how to talk to and command the pet once it arrives on desktop. (why: The home stage takes a long mean time (2336s), and users frequently ask support how to interact or talk with their pet after setup.)

scores.note: Redesigns and tutorials historically showed no positive effect or slight losses.
Strong support evidence, but copy changes historically produce negligible lift.
Layout redesigns showed neutral to negative performance in prior tests.
Waiting screen info consistently drives solid gains and addresses explicit support complaints.
New customization screens have high upside potential but carry mixed historical risks.
Hints on choose_path previously measured a -2.2% decline in conversion.
Layout changes showed no clear positive effect in earlier experiments.
Targets the highest drop-off step at low cost, but copy tweaks rarely produce large gains.
Waiting screen enhancements have proven effective and directly target user confusion.
